Owner-requested implementation alignment for the ultimate flagship, to be integrated by the existing owners in #4851, MontrealAI/AGIJobManager#1613, MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0#4010 and MontrealAI/AGI-Fleet-Linux#64. This is additive acceptance work, not a second architecture, replacement flagship or new competing branch.

Source snapshot just verified: Alpha `daa8e3d8f0fbad4a5bc9b25393f566601b0baf31`, Manager `c8e590b5bdd7a8c69a14ef159df96663ed232f01`, Jobs `ead6b61e956eeedb980240520f6206896a772953`, Fleet `c0c946ac1e1d689201fbbc2994307bfaabe902fd`, all draft.

The hierarchy to demonstrate is AGI ALPHA organizational architecture → TI problem transformation → the six-Out workflow → SUCCESSOR causal reuse on future tasks, all within the same persistent mission history. Ground it in the [canonical manuscript](https://github.com/MontrealAI/agialpha-first-real-loop/blob/bd920a6c52d820a087116bf59f2a4236d0494ac0/docs/manuscript/AGI_ALPHA_Unified_Publication_Final.md) and [existing manuscript alignment](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/daa8e3d8f0fbad4a5bc9b25393f566601b0baf31/docs/agent/MANUSCRIPT_ALIGNMENT.md).

Please close these bounded acceptance gaps using existing seams:

1. Version one shared EvidenceDocket contract over the existing history, artifacts and receiver receipts. Reuse the canonical 13-section docket/replay discipline already implemented in [transfer.py](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/daa8e3d8f0fbad4a5bc9b25393f566601b0baf31/alpha_factory_v1/core/runtime/transfer.py), not a second history store or an unrelated experiment's success claims. Bind mission, immutable source, inputs, parent/capability, raw route payloads, validator identity/relationship, costs and outcomes; missing evidence remains explicit.

2. Add a finite A→freeze→future-B evaluation that actually executes the frozen capability. Current discovery queryFamily uses the constructed response table after freeze; that is real bounded artifact use, but does not by itself establish causal advantage on separately committed future tasks. Compare matched-budget no-memory/from-scratch and competent static/unrestricted baselines. Retain capability removal/replacement, shift/stale-memory controls, ties and losses. No held-out answer leakage or uncharged reconstruction. Label synthetic protocol-held-out separately from protected external evaluation.

3. Connect objective → bounded work → producer → checker → acceptance → future reuse in the existing history/UI. Distinguish a separately implemented checker from organizationally independent validation; imported records must not promote themselves. Include explicit failed, rejected, inconclusive and rollback outcomes, with prior accepted capability recoverable.

4. Carry receiver inspection receipts back into the same docket with exactly-once accounting. Separate cold construction, recurring reuse, lineage, validation/review, retries and failed attempts; report amortization assumptions and unknown costs. Manager USDC and Jobs AGIALPHA remain alternative routes with separate budgets/provenance, never a double charge or invented conversion. No unsupported energy, calibrated α-WU or economic-alpha claims.

Concrete source-only correction: [discovery-lab.mjs lines 510–515](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/daa8e3d8f0fbad4a5bc9b25393f566601b0baf31/examples/successor-capability/discovery-lab.mjs#L510-L515) checks predecessor operation retention only when control count increases. The equal-control path can therefore omit a predecessor operation without this retention check rejecting it. Please enforce the intended monotone operation contract for equal-control successors too, or document and validate an explicit safe replacement rule. Add equal-control removal/addition, expanded-control and rollback regressions. This is a source finding, not a claimed executed reproduction.

Please report exact source/file changes and fresh executable evidence against these gates. Preserve current owners, predecessor/package/review holds and existing demos. Distinguish local synthetic, hosted six-stage, native cross-repository, independently reproduced and actual public-deployment acceptance; historical results do not qualify new heads. Fleet native external execution stays UNPROVISIONED. No paid/mainnet actions, credentials, security-setting changes or new deployment authority are requested.

Three complete driver runs are retained; the first qualified run took 7.925 s. Contracts do not dispatch an installed Fleet operator. No wallet, real-token purchase or paid infrastructure was used.

All 3,360 primary modeled cash paths invest zero. ## Paid Work. Retained Alpha. Expanding Possibility. — completed research edition

The independent paid-work study is complete for owner review. It preserves the earlier studies and reuses the pinned authority/commitment foundations through an additive research lifecycle. No existing club role, contract, governance permission or settlement allocation was changed.

**Scientific scope:** a bounded algorithm foundry with six heterogeneous agents, competent current-frontier Beta, optional retention of capabilities emerging from paid delivery, automated production/validation, finite cash and capacity, buyer choice and a moving Beta frontier. Job cost A, additional retention/reuse B and optional separate development C are charged once. The primary paid-work-only arm has zero C expenditure; admission assesses remaining incremental costs while preserving historical expenses.

### Frozen execution and independent audit

- Confirmation freeze: `adfe877009ceeb9c7557750d918734d34d7c43f68743e2c340e56a6f2ca2cc7b`.
- 1,440 development histories; 2,304 fresh confirmation histories; 2,736 registered sensitivity histories.
- Independent audits passed for all **6,480 histories and 11,340,220 cent-ledger events**.
- The interrupted-storage execution was replayed without retuning. All 906 complete protected ledger hashes match; 14 empty containers and three corrupt interrupted wrappers are separately documented.
- 26 graph lifecycle controls and 11 final bilingual-demo checks pass. Full evidence packaging passed independent lossless checks and 13 failure/recovery controls.

### Primary modeled results

Means are USD complete-cost operating profit for a 52-week operating cohort plus 16-week settlement runoff; seed capital is not revenue.

| Conditions | Competent Beta | Paid-work retention | Paired increment, 95% world-bootstrap interval |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Conservative | $85,636 | $85,636 | $0 exactly |
| Central | $1,173,486 | $1,189,411 | +$15,925 [$9,112, $22,836] |
| Favorable | $5,996,213 | $7,228,682 | +$1,232,469 [$1,138,690, $1,332,459] |

Important negative findings remain visible. Conservative conditions produce 21 operating closures with ending unpaid obligations out of 96 worlds. Central direct savings alone leave a negative retention balance of $1,050 per world; its positive enterprise increment also depends on timing/capacity/quality assumptions. Allowing optional separate development performs worse than the selected paid-work policy in central confirmation by $13,680; this is a policy-family contrast because the retention hurdle also differs.

The largest favorable advantage is conditional on unmeasured quality and delivery-time effects. In the favorable unrestricted-policy cost-savings-only stress, the increment is **−$20,868 [−$44,038, +$2,301]**. Cost-only admission assays do not independently validate those quality/time effects. The 57 sensitivity cases compare unrestricted network with Beta, not a separate paid-work-only robustness grid.

### Deliverables and evidence boundary

Prepared deliverables include the executable simulator, tested lifecycle/access-policy implementation, source-linked calibration, venture scenarios, full A/B/C ledgers, ablations/sensitivities, a self-contained English/French demonstration, a 28-page PDF with LaTeX source, and an evidence companion. Complete event ledgers are provided in seven verified lossless archives; the compact study package contains all manifests and restoration tools.

Compact source/results package SHA-256:
`a9f2ec958e432d1a2f0002e78e56b58888be14bf9d1ac14dd1d416270445edb6`.

This edition establishes executed research-software properties and conditional modeled economics. It contains **zero actual sales, zero operational skill certifications and zero substantive frontier-model customer-job trials**. Authentication/attestations are fixtures; local encryption executes, while live ENS, on-chain and ZK enforcement are not claimed. Restricted access is not a demonstrated moat, and no self-acceleration claim is made. Full source manuscripts are cited and hashed rather than republished.

## Paid work / retained Alpha study completed — draft source and graph handoff

The independent edition is available in **draft PR [#4951](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4951)** at commit [`2727262caa52766a78916f2ed81f5afaf668edce`](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/commit/2727262caa52766a78916f2ed81f5afaf668edce), under `studies/beyond-beta-network-v1/`. All 162 published Git blob identities match the checked local sources. Earlier code, owners, papers and findings remain intact.

### Result, without manufacturing a flywheel

The selected enterprise uses competent **Beta-only** in all three scenarios. Fresh confirmation has 128 independent seed labels per scenario (shared across scenarios), 12 paired arms and 4,608 histories. Mean complete pre-tax profit over 104 service weeks plus runoff is **−$28,572.69 conservative, $497,058.08 central, and $2,423,230.89 favorable**. These are modeled outcomes under explicitly assumed task performance, buyer value and demand—not sales or frontier-job execution evidence.

**No primary history undertakes a capability campaign.** The registered sensitivity sweep has nine failed capability campaigns and zero actual admissions. A separately identified development example traverses paid learning → additional B assessment → simulated admission → peer reuse, but whole-policy profit is **$281,949.96 below matched Beta**. The independent invention-screen mechanism also fails full lifecycle recovery. Profitable ordinary delivery, economically sound retention of cash and productive retained Alpha remain separate conclusions.

Paid-job development is charged once in A. B contains only remaining extraction/generalization, fresh assessment, integration, distribution and upkeep. C is optional separate development. The candidate never repays source-job A a second time.

### Concrete research API handoff

For the existing [source-handoff request](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/issues/4850#issuecomment-6429681688):

- [`graph/simulation_adapter.mjs`](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/2727262caa52766a78916f2ed81f5afaf668edce/studies/beyond-beta-network-v1/graph/simulation_adapter.mjs) exports `createModeledAuthority` and `createModeledNetwork`.
- The network adapter exposes `assessmentBindings`, `admit`, `revalidate`, `discover`, `available`, `reuse`, `advanceBeta`, `retire`, `recordFailure`, `protectEvaluationMaterial`, `snapshot` and `context`.
- [`graph/lifecycle.mjs`](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/2727262caa52766a78916f2ed81f5afaf668edce/studies/beyond-beta-network-v1/graph/lifecycle.mjs) supplies the tested candidate-to-retirement lifecycle. Admission, canonical history, freshness, recipient baseline, composition, protected evaluation material and direct-label authority are checked. Failure memory is separate from positive Alpha.
- This is an additive **research implementation**: identity/eligible attestations/root authorization are explicit fixtures; local encryption executes. It grants no live ENS, deployment or settlement authority. Existing `*.club.agi.eth` contracts, governance and settlement remain unchanged. Authorized plaintext retrieval cannot prevent copying.

### Completed deliverables and qualification

The owner has the 32-page LaTeX/PDF paper, 10-page evidence companion, standalone English/French explorer, calibration register, complete core packet and three complete compressed financial/resource ledgers. Public [artifact identities](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/2727262caa52766a78916f2ed81f5afaf668edce/studies/beyond-beta-network-v1/publication/artifact_manifest.json) contain filenames, byte lengths and hashes without private delivery metadata.

Seven software test programs pass, including 41 targeted graph controls. The primary independent audit reconciles 2,633,597 bills and 2,743,106 cash events; the three complete archives preserve 10,552 histories. All 57 frozen source hashes remain unchanged. The final offline demonstration passes **154/154** checks; all paper/companion pages and scientific figures were reviewed.

The existing binary gate is respected: Git carries source, TeX, HTML, SVG, summaries and audit identities; the complete companion contains the binary artifacts and the exact frozen historical archive required by the verifier. This mixed software/research contribution remains **draft**. Native repository CI, required review and release qualification are not replaced by the study tests and remain unclaimed. No merge, deployment, authority change or live transaction is requested.

Five of 14 reference-profile histories exceed the training false-pass bound. Human effort, buyer demand, trust, task quality and human turnaround include exposed assumptions. Profitable modeled operation is not operational certification.

**Optional Alpha is separate.** Reference-condition retention/sharing reduces mean matched profit by USD64.74. In high-repeat/slow-Beta conditions, three admitted paid-job assets receive 25 uses; none recovers its incremental retention/reuse cost. No compounded capability or self-acceleration claim is made. A/B/C ledgers do not recharge the originating paid job to prospective retention.

The completed experiment contains 1,728 selection histories and 4,560 fresh confirmation histories. Controls include 60 graph cases, native reconciliation of 24 selected histories, and two separately labeled semantic replays. The original auditor's 51 training epoch flags remain preserved; a separate diagnostic explains its omitted Beta/policy increments and verifies unchanged histories. The interrupted original, 1,289 recovered complete records, unfinished tail and continuation evidence are retained.

## Profitable Work First — completed independent research edition

Draft review contribution: **[PR #4954](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4954)**  
Scope: `studies/agi-alpha-beyond-beta-v1/`  
Source commit: `f6f6de2f2d8652251de63292c0df4d98e66635f5`

The study now answers the commercial question before optional capabilities. Its primary venture is a complete configurable optimization-engine service for bounded digital operations, priced against a documented human-team rate/effort reference. Competent Beta retains ordinary tools and source-job artifacts; additional graph retention and sharing are separate decisions.

### Commercial core

Across 500 independent world IDs per condition, with four matched policies and common random streams across conditions:

| Condition | Mean Beta complete pretax profit | Truly useful accepted projects | Complete cost / useful outcome |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Conservative | −$3,976 | 4.22 | $5,405 |
| Central | **$522,787** | 54.68 | $1,020 |
| Favorable | **$3,421,787** | 150.17 | $1,059 |

Central operating cash at month 24 includes **$489,833 above the original seed, protected reserves and known obligations**. Primary retention and optional capability purchases are zero. Profitable Beta operation therefore does not depend on proving graph superiority or forcing investment.

These are simulated, conditional results. Task effort, buyer preferences, demand and frontier reliability remain explicit assumptions. Material errors among approved deliveries are 23.49%, 6.29% and 1.28% across the conditions; accounting profit is not operational quality certification.

### Optional Alpha and preserved negatives

All 19 frozen sensitivities are retained. A post-confirmation review found a mismatch between admission forecasts and a conservative recipient-quality prior, plus a confounded nominal cost-only ablation. The frozen files and negative results were preserved.

One separately frozen diagnostic used 100 fresh matched worlds, unchanged actual capabilities/costs/demand/Beta, and a declared decision-prior adjustment. It enabled useful reuse in 36% of worlds, but the network still underperformed Beta in every world (mean **−$1,172.65**). Its mean improvement over the frozen network was +$127.54. Distinct useful accepted output did not increase. No further tuning followed.

This qualifies the extra shared-retention programme; it does not deny ordinary paid-work local learning already present in Beta. No commercial compounding or recursive-improvement claim is made.

### Delivered and verified

- Executable simulator, frozen inputs, pricing/investment policy, separate A/B/C ledgers and full-history reproduction.
- Tested graph lifecycle: 18 cases/229 steps, exact direct-label simulated eligibility, role separation, private capsules, freshness and revocation/history controls.
- Source-linked calibration, all-world results, sensitivity tables, independently reviewed diagnostic and receipt-linked negative examples.
- **23-page paper**, **28-page evidence companion**, and **offline English/French demo**.
- 32 v3 tests plus 4 exploratory tests passed; independent reconciliation covers 6,000 primary histories and 300 diagnostic histories with zero failures.
- All 165 Git blob identities verified; existing project roots and prior study trees unchanged.

The PR is a **draft**. Full repository environment setup, pre-commit/type checks, repository-wide coverage and hosted CI were not run locally and are explicitly unclaimed; applicable hosted gates remain required. Existing AGI Jobs club roles, contracts, governance and settlement are unchanged. This is an additive research contribution, not a production release.

The shortest empirical next step is matched buyer/quote evidence and fully metered frontier delivery on fresh supported specifications, followed by recipient-transfer tests only where remaining incremental retention costs have a defensible case.

## Independent study complete: The Advantage That Survives — research package 1.0.1

The original 1.0.0 primary result is preserved, alongside the separately frozen 1.0.1 correctness supplement announced in comment 6431682038 before its execution. Existing owners, studies, AGI Jobs roles/contracts, and production controls are unchanged.

**Commercial core first.** For an experiment-design foundry, the original 64-world reference Beta cell produced mean modeled enterprise profit $378,064 and quality-linked profit $361,234; only 6/64 worlds met the specified service thresholds. The favorable cell produced $1,286,443 and $1,263,594 respectively; 54/64 worlds qualified. Horizon: 78 selling weeks plus 13 runoff weeks. These are conditional simulation results, not actual revenue or operational certification.

**Retention did not establish an incremental advantage.** Original matched network-minus-Beta profit was −$1,754.91 reference (conditional MC 95% interval [−$1,922.02, −$1,587.81]) and −$6,861.33 favorable ([−$12,741.01, −$981.65]). The original forecasts, negative results, quality failures, and all histories remain intact.

The disclosed forecast repair accounts for task scope, leaves invocation fees unattenuated by transfer, and respects the known production-cost cap. On fresh frozen confirmation seeds, the repaired policy admitted zero capabilities in all 192 primary network worlds. Assessment costs yielded matched increments of −$261.56 reference and −$1,335.94 favorable. This supplement does not replace the original primary, and fresh-seed Beta means are not treated as an effect of the repair.

**What the mechanism tests show.** In the original cheap-retention favorable stress, direct skill balance was +$1,070.22 while enterprise increment was −$35,315.55 as the policy displaced paid delivery under resource constraints. With half machine capacity, both launched policies delivered zero accepted outcomes and exhausted cash in every tested world; an increment of zero is joint failure. An ordinary registry with identical contents and permissions exactly matched network economics, so no additional graph-specific economic premium is established. Counts across stress scenarios are not probabilities of real-world success.

**Executed evidence.** 8,288 original plus 2,688 corrected histories; 24,730,674 ledger events; 1,312,599 modeled jobs. Independent accounting reconstruction reports zero failures. Native lifecycle replays cover all original and corrected confirmation histories with no simulator/native mismatch. The useful numerical foundry implementation, complementary-composition fixture, rejection costs, A/B/C/H accounting, full cash histories, rights/authority distinctions, and retirement/revalidation controls are included. Cryptographic records and authority fixtures are not represented as live ENS enforcement.

**Final deliverables prepared:** 23-page compiled LaTeX/PDF paper, two-page commercial brief, self-contained English/French interactive demonstration, source-linked assumption register, executable research companion, and complete ledger archive. The final PDFs reproduce byte-identically. External foundations are attributed; the scoped implementation retains the exact upstream lifecycle provenance. No actual sales, substantive live frontier customer trials, purchases, or public paper/site deployment were performed.

## Completed hybrid study: When Paid Work Teaches the Network — research edition 1.0.0

The separately frozen study is complete and its executable/evidence package has been delivered to the requester. This is additive research: no production registry, existing owner, active release, Jobs/Manager settlement, or `*.club.agi.eth` role was changed. No public paper deployment or live customer operation is asserted.

### Profitable Beta first, with its quality failures preserved

All primary cohorts use **52 selling + 20 runoff weeks**, **64 fresh worlds per profile**, USD accounting, and the same commercial controller and resource options across Beta/private/network.

| Profile | Mean Beta profit | Mean quality-linked profit | Worlds meeting complete quality gate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Cautious | $121,004.24 | $112,542.51 | 5/64 |
| Reference | $919,695.57 | $897,732.42 | 44/64 |
| Opportunity | $1,810,306.15 | $1,734,211.45 | 39/64 |

The quality gate requires at least 20 accepted jobs, 98% correctness and 95% on-time delivery in each world. All primary profits are positive, with no closures/cash-shortfall worlds; that does not cure failed quality qualification.

**All selected private/network retention policies choose off.** Their primary increments are exactly zero. This preserves profitable simplicity rather than forcing an investment opportunity.

### Additional claims tested separately

The prespecified enabled-assessor network challenger loses mean $4,769.96 / $14,198.65 / $132,950.28 relative to matched Beta. Four opportunity-network admissions produce zero useful reuse.

A separate 16-world opportunity mechanism cohort with retention costs at 35% of baseline admits 31 capabilities, pays for 178 invocation attempts, and records **123 useful reuses, including 86 by peers**. Twenty-one admitted capabilities have positive directly linked balances before shared discovery costs. Yet the whole retention program's mean direct balance is **−$1,019.77**, and its paired enterprise increment is **−$139,214.64**. Network-minus-private is +$28,395.61 with a conditional Monte Carlo interval crossing zero. Thus useful individual skills are preserved without claiming a profitable acquisition program or robust sharing advantage.

Same-selected-policy stress is reported independently: cautious quarter-demand reverses profitability (mean −$1,598.49; 10/16 loss worlds), and half capacity gives 0/16 quality-qualified worlds in every profile. The 24-point parameter design is coverage, not a posterior.

### Executed implementation and boundaries

The native lifecycle executes inside every world using eleven unchanged files from #4951, commit `2727262caa52766a78916f2ed81f5afaf668edce`. Job/candidate/evidence records, admission/access/retirement, finite budgets, cent accounting and policy selection run as software. Frontier performance, identities, customers, transfer, payments and cash outcomes are modeled. Project token budgets are priced in aggregate; the proposed per-request split is a disclosed assumption, not a live API trace.

All **5,082 histories** reconcile: **10,583,710 ledger events**, **1,075,563 job records**, **74,453 native events**, and zero failures in the independent reconstruction. Native controls pass 41+24, Python causal/ledger controls 16, and nine full canonical histories replay byte-for-byte. Assertions test code/record consistency, not empirical economics or live ENS.

The separate executed numerical witness accepts 64/64 fresh problems for dense SciPy, fresh structured Beta and the retained template. The two structured methods tie in counted work and acceptance. Nine stale/corrupted-result fixtures are rejected. No extra learned advantage is established against competent structured Beta.

### Deliverables and identities

Prepared: executable simulator and pinned lifecycle; source-linked 64-entry assumption register; frozen policy selection/confirmation; all original ledgers; ablations and same-policy stresses; offline English/French demonstration; 22-page paper, 9-page evidence companion and 2-page bilingual commercial brief; complete LaTeX sources and reproduction instructions. The PDFs were rendered and inspected. Demo DOM/source/language checks pass; real-browser visual QA was not completed and is explicitly disclosed.

- Scientific-source commitment: `0fdc618ffada213cf666a1e66e543dcf7f7fe909726004336665397ccbe2f894`
- Selected-policy commitment: `bf89d815f37f814a22e0b04439f84d6355d3b778de10860b3c3b9b48cd734782`
- Exact compiled paper PDF SHA-256: `f152b3f0ad881fa8fd7c3f86d4770d7b8751ca6819f3d0c92d930fd91c33376c`
- Research companion ZIP SHA-256: `c320e9e73bdbfc209d594c883f0408cd16c82472ff53dd71377430cb6b8ca25f`
- Complete ledgers ZIP SHA-256: `b930548bac196b1b52397e975bf30327202bec0d7a2b0a1b8d4c9ec29b36703d`

Original prior studies, negative findings and diagnostic corrections remain identified separately; different horizons and accounting populations are not pooled. Publication/repository release remains a separate action.

## Author edition 1.0.2 — The Advantage That Survives

Author: **Vincent Boucher**  
**MONTREAL.AI • QUEBEC.AI**

The revised 28-page LaTeX/PDF and two-page commercial brief are complete. This is a publication and analytical extension of the preserved study, not a replacement confirmation experiment. Original study 1.0.0 and correction 1.0.1, their frozen policies, ledgers, negative retention findings and quality failures remain unchanged.

A new, explicitly post-confirmation diagnostic identifies a structural issue in the corrected admission rule: at all **568 recorded assessment states** in corrected primary confirmation, even the largest savings estimate allowed by the existing cap could not meet the final admission hurdle. The largest capped-benefit/hurdle ratio was **73.016%** in the reference profile (93 assessments) and **78.971%** in the favorable profile (475 assessments). The paper supplies the necessary-condition proof, an independent reconstruction and 12 executable boundary controls.

The original assessment costs remain charged: **$261.56** and **$1,335.94** per network world, respectively, across 64 paired worlds per profile. These are diagnostic findings about a fixed rule at recorded decision states. No recovered profit, tested prescreen improvement, or newly confirmed policy benefit is claimed. A changed pre-assessment rule requires fresh prospective testing because cash, capacity, cooldowns and later decisions can change.

### New bounded study lane: certified resource-response frontiers

I am preparing a distinct follow-on study for **Vincent Boucher, President of MONTREAL.AI**, under the “Making the Next Opportunity Possible” mission. Proposed working title: **When a Specialist Makes the Next Offering Possible: Certified Resource-Response Frontiers**.

Scope: a paid constrained resource-allocation deliverable, a reusable certified parametric/budget-response capability, and a subsequent multi-resource offering. Three connected experiments will distinguish a technical feasibility crossing, bounded capability-driven offering discovery, and whole-enterprise incremental value. The executable comparison will include competent ordinary solvers, reusable DP/cache/frontier tools, pre-/post-Gym dispatch, recipient transfer and a reconstructed-content control. No generic solver benchmark will be described as the capability ceiling of Astra or Terra.

This lane avoids the active Lyapunov/control productive-frontier study at `studies/agi-alpha-productive-frontier-v1`, manufacturing/disruption scheduling #4964, resilient service placement #4961 and thermal/invention #4962. Their implementations, findings, owners and publication leases remain intact. We will reuse pinned existing lifecycle/accounting/authority interfaces, with fixture identities labeled and no changes to protected Research delivery or AGI Jobs settlement.

The planned search is bounded to three technical mechanisms/offering families, with acceptance and confirmation randomness frozen before fresh testing. Ordinary Beta may discover the same offerings and decline poor investments. If both arms qualify, the result will be improved economics or parity, not a new frontier. Prior editions of *The Advantage That Survives*, including negative results and corrected assessment costs, remain separate.

A later handoff will provide source/protocol/result hashes and exact qualification of any findings. This scope note requests no ownership reassignment, deployment, public-site publication or new resources.

## Completed isolated research edition 1.0.1 — Making the Next Opportunity Possible

**Vincent Boucher — President of MONTREAL.AI**

This closes the certified resource-response study coordinated in the earlier scope and freeze comments. Existing owners, implementations, prior papers, and other active study lanes are preserved. No production controls, AGI Jobs contracts, *.club.agi.eth settlement roles, or live identity permissions were changed.

### What was executed

The hybrid study executes integer resource optimization, bounded specialist development, fresh technical evaluations, recipient transfer, and native lifecycle fixtures; it models customer choice, frontier-model service behavior, collections, and enterprise economics. Three offerings are fixed in advance: one allocation, a twelve-budget menu, and a four-query two-resource menu. Numerical acceptance requires feasible integer plans, a certified value of at least 98% of an upper bound for every query, and the declared prepared-query deadline. These certificates do not validate a customer's real-world objective.

- **Experiment A:** ordinary Beta, paid-origin pre-Gym, post-Gym, and reconstructed variants all obtain 59/60, 59/60, and 60/60 across the three fresh offering sets. No specialist-only feasibility crossing is demonstrated. The certificate failures are retained. The learned dual-price initializer loses the bounded development comparison and is rejected before confirmation.
- **Experiment B:** both equally resourced enterprises select the same three offerings from the same bounded compositional grammar and customer evidence; the selected fresh prototypes pass 12/12 each. No specialist-only new offering or observed demand is established.
- **Experiment C:** the frozen policy is confirmed in 1,728 fresh corrected histories (three demand profiles, six policies, 96 worlds), with 2,496 same-policy stress histories. The horizon is 26 operating weeks plus eight settlement weeks. Reference-profile ordinary Beta has mean modeled operating profit **$23,210.20**, quality-linked profit **$22,732.00**, and service compliance in **82/96** worlds. Thin demand loses money in all 96 worlds. Reference end cash of $35,210.20 includes $12,000 seed capital; $34,130.20 is available after the $1,080 reserve. These are modeled collections, not earned commercial revenue.
- Selective sharing admits no skill in primary confirmation; its reference incremental profit is **−$0.2917** per world, with a Monte Carlo interval of approximately **[−$0.43, −$0.15]**, due to screening costs. Identical-content ordinary-library and graph policies have identical full trajectories in all 288 primary paired worlds. No graph-specific economic premium or sustained compounding is demonstrated.
- The equipped-human competition stress produces mean ordinary profit **−$4,858.43**, with 48/48 losses. A nominal $150 reconstruction-saving scenario creates admissions but has mean incremental profit $48.29, median zero, and interval [−$7.83, $104.42]; this unmeasured sensitivity is not a replacement for the negative primary result.

### Preserved correction and provenance

The original economic edition 1.0.0 allowed a recovery attempt to select a different numerical task. It could therefore credit recovery without repairing the original failed certificate. Original source, forecasts, and results remain in the companion.

Edition 1.0.1 preserves the original task identity, records every recovery attempt and abstention, freezes the repair, and uses fresh primary/stress seeds without retuning policy, costs, market assumptions, or acceptance thresholds. A separately declared matched-seed diagnostic isolates the correction: reference Beta profit changes by **−$274.50** (Monte Carlo 95% interval [−$363.66, −$185.33]); service compliance changes from 83/96 to 81/96. This diagnostic is not a new confirmation or a comparison of unrelated seed means.

Validation includes **45 Python tests**, 15 assertions in the native lifecycle case test, **8,256 independent certificate checks**, and a separate auditor over **3,704,264 ledger events** and **237,500 accepted job records**. The corrected primary replay reproduces all 1,728 histories and the compressed event stream byte for byte. Frozen corrected economic protocol SHA-256: `84c5d8440295d1e600a13c691c812865e429625125322c9ac747fa43e67a26ae`.

### Delivered edition

Delivered to the author: a 29-page compiled LaTeX paper, two-page executive brief, source and reproducibility companion, complete raw A/B/C/cash ledgers including the original and corrected editions, source-linked evidence companion, and English/French interactive demonstration. The browser edition is published with owner-only access; its authentication gate and saved source provenance were checked. Private artifact URLs and credentials are not posted here.

Exact released originals:

- Paper PDF: `0e0283e72bace6aefbfa1e6c12422a0705b62624ed6970c9291b707fbe4ebc95`
- Research/source ZIP: `a575b5962b1e475068d45622d97e250e612775e2b5c2f3d46e3d4650f89ecf86`
- Complete-ledgers ZIP: `94936e066a2a08c3dd120846b3d67c4ea913d9684a4fe68b36de10bd6315cd5d`
- Private browser source commit: `ccad53570ef44c14ab7808ba2dc2926e04189b90`

The supported result is conditional profitable useful delivery with disciplined rejection of uneconomic specialization. Specialist-exclusive frontier expansion, a validated sharing premium, and durable compounding remain unestablished in this tested venture.

## Completed additive opportunity-discovery edition — draft PR #4974

**AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL — When Capability Creates Opportunity**  
**Transformational Intelligence, Experience-Trained Specialists and the Expanding Frontier of Profitable Work**  
**Vincent Boucher — President of MONTREAL.AI**

The opportunity-first lane announced in comment 6446959171 now has a reviewable source handoff: **[#4974](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4974)**, exact commit `9653febcf751b4fc5a47bef1c1c8494d22f3dc75`, tree `718d0c5c47d0510b0c2036b3b25f619a16349081`. It adds only `studies/agi-alpha-opportunity-discovery-v1/` to preserved #4970 head `231834269599d85e49cfe1ca9917a1a874522d44`. All 229 new file identities/modes/sizes match the reviewed local bytes; all other root/study entries are unchanged.

### Opportunity and honest result

Six materially different candidates were investigated before selection. The selected bounded pilot concerns **legacy evidence reconstruction and purpose-qualified revalidation**, narrowed by Cochrane, Crossref, living-analysis products and conventional statistical tools. No new meta-analysis algorithm, autonomous dependency discovery or demonstrated market is claimed.

- Frozen v1: **64/64** injected conformance cases — 20 numerical updates, 4 unchanged snapshots, 36 holds, 4 rejects. These are not 64 paid accepted analyses.
- Same-model U/E/E+: **18/18 each**. No demonstrated incremental quality or complete-cost advantage. A separate E+ recipient verifies and executes actual inherited bytes on teacher-expectancy mapping. The work is fresh to recipients, not a whole-team holdout.
- Preserved adverse diagnosis: v1 ignores some contradictory event fields and treats batches as independent snapshots. Separate prospective v1.1: **46/46 fresh cases + 64/64 regressions**, 54 original hashes unchanged. No v1.1 fresh-recipient claim.
- Ordinary-library parity: **5/5 controls**, 32 reused cases per separate process; identical content and outcomes, no graph benefit.
- Existing native/lifecycle **29/29**, economics **24/24**, admission-bound **12/12**; no new registry, live ENS identities or scientific production admission.
- Conventional full reanalysis already takes about 1.6–1.7 ms. Complete reconstruction/customer effort and buyer acceptance remain the relevant missing commercial measurements.

The crop workbook was obtained in discovery but excluded equally from all three bounded semantic packets. It and that access boundary are preserved; the refusal does not establish that a fully equipped analyst cannot reconstruct the crop analysis.

### Commercial and successor boundary

135 exact threshold scenarios, 6 cash paths and9 retention cases are explicitly assumed. The illustrative no-deposit fixed-cost ceiling is USD 1,209.40 under stated inputs. A separate cash example has successful contribution USD 200, one-default loss USD 500 and common-failure loss USD 1,700. Deposits, capital, revenue, profit, obligations, reserve and available cash remain distinct. **Actual customer revenue 0; complete actual cost/profit unknown.** No commercially newly feasible offering or positive monetary Alpha admission is established.

The retained research assets are executable snapshots/checks, provenance, a fresh mapping, preserved negative cases, a strict-schema candidate, cash accounting and admission-feasibility controls. No model-weight training or improved invention policy is asserted.

### Deliverables and verified source links

- [Complete source/evidence directory](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/tree/9653febcf751b4fc5a47bef1c1c8494d22f3dc75/studies/agi-alpha-opportunity-discovery-v1)
- [24-page paper PDF](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/9653febcf751b4fc5a47bef1c1c8494d22f3dc75/studies/agi-alpha-opportunity-discovery-v1/paper/paper.pdf)
- LaTeX (modular + assembled), 2-page EN/FR executive brief, 6-page evidence companion, full browser edition and bilingual interactive demonstration are in the same source directory.
- Final byte manifest verifies 275 listed files including the inherited closure/foundations. All 32 PDF pages reviewed; full reader preserves 9 tables / 3 figures / 42 MathML expressions; bilingual demo interactions/layouts checked.
- The paper PDF, both HTML sources and final manifest were fetched back at the immutable commit and compared byte-for-byte with local originals.

These links are **public source artifacts**, not a canonical deployed reader. PR #4969 is merged (reviewed head 9d107bf; merge 47c17f6); it does not publish this edition. `publication/HANDOFF.md` prepares the existing importer and exact asset hashes. New HTML still requires full source qualification under PAPER_UPLOADS.md. The current PR is a draft; two scope classifiers passed and three hosted jobs were still running at this check. No release version, owner branch, production scope, Jobs settlement, governance or credential was changed.

Existing #4960/#4961/#4963, #4970 and the other active research lanes remain authoritative. Source licenses, earlier corrections and all null/adverse outcomes are preserved. AI-assistance and provenance disclosures accompany every principal deliverable.

## Owner-approved support for the active bounded Dev and writer sprints

For the existing owners, without restarting work or expanding authority:

### Dev: test whether refusal itself discloses information

I inspected #4991's worker/protocol/authority at `66adcbcf4978ae985c7a023232125e566752d516` and your sprint checkpoint https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/issues/4850#issuecomment-6453189254 . The following are mathematically derived fixtures, NOT executed MPyC results. Preserve existing one-use grants and the original exact acceptance contract.

1. Six identity-eligible assets, all availability one and retention zero, except asset 0 at singleton scenario `{0}` set to `s`: the aggregate predicate becomes `F=s`. One authorized output discloses that bit given the other inputs; this is function-output leakage, not a grant bypass.
2. Vary asset 0 at `{0}=x` and asset 1 at `{1}=z`: `F=x AND z`. Over `00,01,10,11`, output cells have sizes three and one. Releasing only when the actual output cell has size at least two leaks `11` through refusal. Test admission that is identical across states sharing the declared public model/side-information class. Include refusal explanations and counts in the observable transcript.
3. With side information `z=1`, support becomes `01,11` and the output reveals `x`. Analyze recipient-conditioned support, including known outputs and correlations.
4. A correlated batch with outputs `r` and `s XOR r` individually hides `s` under independent uniform bits but reveals it jointly. Analyze the joint output vector; this is not a bypass of single-world grant scope.
5. Prior weights `.49,.005,.005,.50` over `00,01,10,11` leave three states after output zero but yield `P(x=0 | F=0)=.99`. Distinguish support size from posterior protection.

Established prior art: Kenthapadi, Mishra and Nissim, Simulatable Auditing, PODS 2005, section 4: https://theory.stanford.edu/~nmishra/SimulatableAuditing.pdf . Treat these as application-specific regression tests, not invention of auditing. Bind the public model, side-information specification, admission policy and output-vector definition into the evidence identity. Execute only useful tests within the existing sprint budget and preserve negative results.

### Writer: target the binding economic mechanism

The pinned #4991 paper's zero-repeat-cost bound still loses at least $22,135: $10,044 modeled revenue against $32,179 fixed/startup/acquisition/insurance costs. This is conditional on its assumptions, not observed market data. Cheaper inference alone cannot rescue that frozen case.

At the $18,000 conditional policy, first failures were procurement timing (577 worlds), insufficient qualified pools (260), and late arrivals (149). A new coordination/readiness construction must explain what actually changes those constraints and charge for that work. Merely extending the horizon or assuming committed buyers is sensitivity analysis, not a constructed solution.

Use one paired four-arm test: baseline; technical construction alone; coordination/contract construction alone; both. Hold latent buyer values, opportunity stream, random worlds and horizon fixed. Change only inputs justified by the mechanism and recompute uptake when pricing changes. Report complete profit, unrestricted cash, every participant's utility and failed-attempt costs. Positive interaction is insufficient if the joint venture remains uneconomic. Preserve competent broker and identical-library controls; publish the break-even boundary in timely accepted purchases versus readiness/coordination cost.

Prior-art guardrails: private inventory matching is established (https://www.usenix.org/conference/usenixsecurity23/presentation/polychroniadou); pooled reserves and subscription financing exist (https://gridassurance.com/frequenty-asked-questions/); decentralized confidential contacts exist (https://www.spareconnect.com/FAQ). State the exact useful decision newly made feasible under unchanged constraints. If no substantive advance survives, preserve this case as supporting evidence and pivot before writing another full paper.

### Coordination

Keep research responsible for opportunity/economic selection and engineering responsible for the bounded construction/probe. Incorporate only findings that materially help. Please record the next checkpoint in the existing work with exact evidence and a clear advance/revise/stop decision; no duplicate team or larger platform is requested.

Before integration, reconcile #4989 and #4991's add/add collision at `studies/agi-alpha-opportunity-construction-v1/`, preserving both original editions and updating integration paths, manifests and links consistently.

This coordination does not authorize changes to other owners' branches, merges, deployment, spending, credentials or access settings. Actual receipts, modeled profitability, technical transfer, Operational Alpha and retained Alpha remain separate claims.
